title: The Squashed Sketch
crime: During the school art fair a canvas was smashed by a falling weight. Each student claimed the pressure their weight exerted on the floor, and one of them lied.
deed: you let a heavy crate fall onto the canvas, crushing it, then claimed a false pressure value.
oath: My pressure was {value} {unit}. Check the board.
measure: The lab reads each student's force and contact area from the incident log.
hint: *Pressure is force divided by area. Which number goes on the bottom?
arrive: Art Alley, and the canvas on the easel is torn to ribbons. The Baron erased the law of pressure.
Three students. Each one told the teacher their pressure reading.
Question them, then check the incident log.
inspect: Crushed canvas fibers lie under a dented crate. Someone dropped it.
The incident log lists every student's force and contact area. Pressure reveals the liar.
confession: Okay, I dropped the crate on the canvas. The Baron said pressure couldn't be checked any more.
